cases.name: wpf-fail

cases.name: mock-full

cases.name: parent-fail
cases.verified: Injected parent output failure while both children sleep; both PIDs gone before artifact lease can be reacquired.

cases.name: partial-start

cases.name: build-fail

cases.name: test-fail
cases.verified: Single-scope exit 37 remains test-failed after registration.

cases.name: keep
cases.verified: Compatibility KeepArtifacts retains/queues outputs; same owned output may be reused.

cases.name: foreign
cases.verified: Unowned output is rejected before build or modification.

cases.name: locked
cases.verified: Busy output lease rejects a second invocation without replacing owner evidence.

cases.name: invalid
cases.verified: Explicit empty filters reject before build/cleanup and retain prior outputs.

cases.name: source-root
cases.verified: Repository root is rejected as ArtifactsPath before build/write.

cases.name: busy-file
cases.verified: Occupied output files are retained and registered, without deletion attempts.

cases.name: registration-failure
cases.verified: Invalid cleanup database remains unchanged; overall status fails and outputs remain until fixture cleanup.

compatibility.reason: Both current and HEAD runner require PowerShell 7.0; the original dirty runner also used SHA256.HashData and Convert.ToHexString. Windows PowerShell 5.1 was not a supported entry path.
compatibility.argumentListApiEvidence: Read-only current-runtime reflection of ProcessStartInfo.GetProperty("ArgumentList") returned non-null.

cleanup.automaticCleanup: The fixture try/finally removed only this owned directory after checking its resolved absolute path and owner.

limits: Mock runners prove process overlap, UTF-8 roundtrip and lifecycle; real-suite elapsed time and actual C# runner output require the root controlled verification.
The mock uses an external-script dotnet shim; installed dotnet resolves to Application.
No real game build, routine or Full run was started by this mock.
